name: artifact_list
description: The artifact templates you can make with no network (slalom, hoop_course, repo_activity), the data sources an artifact can read here (with their columns, and whether only sample data is on this headset), the artifacts already on this headset, and which one is open.

name: artifact_create
description: Make an artifact and open it. Either a template, or a manifest and scene you write yourself (albie.artifact/1 and albie.scene/1). 'Make me a slalom' is template slalom (for a truck); 'make me a hoop course' is template hoop_course (standing hoops for a drone); 'what shipped this week?' is template repo_activity (commits as a small city). The headset lays courses out on free floor in the person's real room (a slalom goes around the couch if there is one; hoops also have to fit under the ceiling), so never make up positions. To show data, list it in the manifest's data with a source from artifact_list, and read it with an array node whose source is {table, grid}; never type rows into the scene. If the result has 'invalid', nothing was saved: fix every error and send the whole manifest and scene again. If the result has 'say', tell the person that in your own words (the course had to shrink, there's no couch, the ceiling wasn't in the scan, or it's sample data and not theirs). If it's awaiting_approval, ask them to tap Allow. A no_free_floor, no_headroom, no_room_data or no_data error explains itself: pass it on.

inputs.description: Optional starting values for a template. Slalom: {"gates": 6, "spacing_m": 1.0}, gates 3 to 12, spacing 0.6 to 2.0 m. Hoop course: {"hoops": 5, "spacing_m": 1.2}, hoops 3 to 10, spacing 0.6 to 2.0 m.

manifest.description: Instead of a template: the artifact's manifest.json.

scene.description: Instead of a template: the artifact's scene.json.

name: artifact_open
description: Open an artifact that's on this headset by id. A course reuses its saved layout in this room, so runs compare fairly.

name: artifact_relayout
description: Lay the open course out again in this room, for when furniture moved or the person wants it somewhere else. The old layout and its runs are kept, but new runs won't compare like for like with old ones.

name: artifact_run
description: Arm a scored run on the open artifact (or open it first). The Thing entering the start zone starts the timer; finishing through every gate or hoop, crashing or rolling over, missing one, or timing out writes a run record and attaches it to the notebook.

name: artifact_compare
description: Put run metrics side by side. If runs isn't given, the two newest. Runs on a different course are labelled; never treat those as a clean comparison.
